raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions has 4946 rows but only 4802 distinct txn_ids (ids 900001–904802 are contiguous). Some transactions were delivered more than once across daily batches, and silver_transactions does not deduplicate, so 138 POSTED txn_ids are double-counted in every gold table. I could not see whether the repeated rows are identical or carry differing values, so the fix keeps the most recently ingested version of each transaction.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) latest WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
